attributes.name: Splashbolt Crossbow
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d10. You may additionally recharge this card to add another 1d6 and the Acid, Cold, Electricity, Fire, or Poison trait.

If proficient with weapons, discard this card to add 1d6 and the Acid, Cold, Electricity, Fire, or Poison trait to another character's combat check.

If proficient with weapons, reveal this card and discard a card that has the Liquid trait to add 1d6 and the discarded card's traits to another character's combat check.
